data.one_liner: Show touch indicators on the screen for screencasts and app demos.
data.what_it_does: Shows up to 5 touch indicators where you touch the screen. It wraps around your app or routes to display visual indicators that are fully customizable.
use_when: Recording a screencast or video demo of your Flutter app
Presenting your app live to an audience
avoid_when: Building standard production user interfaces where touch ripples are not needed
Targeting platforms where touch indicators are unnecessary
strengths: Easy to integrate by wrapping the MaterialApp builder
Supports customization of color, size, and custom indicator widgets
Works across multiple platforms including Android, iOS, and web
weaknesses: Limited to a maximum of 5 touch indicators
Not intended for core functional app features
data.setup_notes: Just add the dependency and wrap your routes or MaterialApp builder in the TouchIndicator widget.
